scope: Compare current public peer support claims with route-specific status, implementation lineage, and evidence boundaries for CADKernel, dwg-rs, uncad/undxf, and OpenCADStudio.

method.kind: Primary project repository and API documentation audit
method.evidenceBoundary: Claims are from public project pages/docs and are not reproduced behavior. CADKernel source status is internally inconsistent, so its detailed route rows are treated as narrower than its overview and FAQ. dwg-rs remains explicitly pre-alpha and its published percentages are inconsistent. uncad documents distinct DWG/DXF parser lineages and is read-only. OpenCADStudio's codec is ACadRust-derived; app self-readback is not independent parser evidence. No local defect or external semantic evidence was established.

evidence.topic: CADKernel headline compatibility versus explicit format routes
observed: The compatibility overview advertises 60+ formats and broad FreeCAD feature parity.
The detailed format table marks ACIS SAT/SAB read and write unsupported.
The same detailed table marks DWG and DXF read/write supported, while the FAQ says commercial CAD file import is planned.
The tech-stack table says STEP I/O is planned although the format table lists STEP AP203/AP214 read/write as supported.
doesNotEstablish: a runnable ACIS, DWG, DXF, or STEP parser/writer route
a per-version or per-feature test matrix
actual interoperable behavior against libdxfrw output
evidence.planUse: Keep CADKernel discovery-only and outside parser/kernel quorum unless an immutable source revision exposes a concrete route and a generated control demonstrates it. Use narrow route-specific status rather than headline support copy.

evidence.topic: dwg-rs route maturity and denominator limits
observed: The project describes itself as pre-alpha.
The current capability notes distinguish a stronger DWG container/object-stream layer from partial entity graph and symbol-table decoding.
The DXF parser is listed as absent; DWG/DXF writers are alpha, and external CAD acceptance is not automated.
Its verification section separates a 19-file container corpus from entity-decoding percentages, and the README contains internally inconsistent aggregate coverage figures.
doesNotEstablish: complete entity, object graph, DXF, writer, or ACIS semantics
a directly comparable corpus denominator for libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: Admit only as an optional exact-pin DWG container/record-boundary comparator. Require matching input hashes and denominators; report framing separately from semantic decode and output acceptance.

evidence.topic: uncad parser lineage and read-only projection boundary
observed: The project states that DWG parsing uses LibreDWG via FFI while DXF parsing uses the separate undxf crate.
Its output route is model/JSON/SVG/PNG and it explicitly does not write DWG/DXF or convert between them.
doesNotEstablish: an independent DWG parser relative to LibreDWG
writer fidelity, graph-preserving round-trip, or ACIS B-rep semantics
evidence.planUse: Record DWG and DXF routes independently; consider only a pinned undxf DXF parser/projection run in the existing optional lane. Do not count uncad as a separate DWG vote.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio application, codec, and geometry-stage separation
observed: OpenCADStudio v2026.41 is an application-level consumer route; its opencadcodec identifies itself as a fork of ACadRust.
Its ACIS tessellation notes distinguish kernel results from a per-surface fallback marked incomplete.
A released application claim does not prove that the app was run against a specific libdxfrw artifact.
doesNotEstablish: a second independent DWG/DXF parser lineage relative to ACadRust
complete ACIS body semantics from visible mesh output
native reference-CAD acceptance from app self-readback
evidence.planUse: Retain only as an optional composed application/display gate with exact release and engine pins, actual output magic, and explicit fallback/loss outcomes. Reject incomplete fallback as semantic success.

existingOwnersOnly: S8 peer and native evidence separation
nextActions: Continue fast local implementation slices; do not add per-slice peer installs or runs.

Before a peer result enters a matrix cell, bind immutable project/artifact identity, dependency lineage, operation, actual format version, corpus provenance and denominator, and an independently authored expected manifest.
Keep parser, writer, graph, display/kernel, and native consumer outcomes in separate fields; report unavailability as NOT_RUN or DISCOVERY_ONLY.
Keep all six external-only J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
